title: FoAntiDupe
description: Flag risky item transfers with GUI-managed anti-dupe rules.
body:
![FoAntiDupe cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZbHCKtm/images/bb4523861881b5c0593fe9d917d290f884646d94.png)

FoAntiDupe helps staff catch suspicious item duplication without instantly interrupting normal gameplay. It flags configured item amounts, sends clear staff alerts, and gives reviewers a fast path from the alert to the player's live inventory.

## Features
- **Review-first anti-dupe detection** - flags suspicious inventory and drop amounts for staff review instead of cancelling actions by default.
- **Ready-made high-value presets** - ships with configurable Lifesteal/SMP-focused rules for diamond blocks, netherite, ancient debris, enchanted golden apples, shulker boxes, and other stash items.
- **Broad event coverage** - can scan after inventory clicks, inventory drags, item pickups, item drops, crafting, and player joins.
- **Nested stash detection** - counts matching items inside shulker boxes and bundles so hidden bulk storage still matches the configured rules.
- **Clickable staff alerts** - staff see the player, rule, amount, and reason, then can click straight into the flagged player's live inventory.
- **Admin rule editor** - manage rules in-game, add rules from a held item, tune inventory/drop thresholds, and choose exact item, name, lore, enchant, or custom model data matching.
- **Audit-friendly logging** - writes flag and review activity to the plugin's own latest log file for later staff follow-up.

![Flag rule presets for high-value items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qZbHCKtm/images/30b38f83c2808b6838dda53f35a7d40d01bec62b.png)

## Commands
- `/foantidupe editor` - open the in-game rule and settings editor.
- `/foantidupe reload` - reload `config.yml`, `messages.yml`, and `dialogs/`.
- `/foantidupe version` - show the plugin author and version.

Alias: `/fad`

## Permissions
- `foantidupe.admin` - use admin commands and the editor, and receive/open flag alerts.
- `foantidupe.show` - receive flag alerts and open editable live inventories.
- `foantidupe.showonly` - receive flag alerts and open live inventories in read-only mode.
- `foantidupe.bypass` - bypass FoAntiDupe checks.
